component.name: AICHE Desktop
component.summary: AI-powered audio transcription and text enhancement

description.p: AICHE Desktop is a professional audio transcription and text enhancement application. Record audio from your microphone, get AI-powered transcriptions, enhance text with AI, search your history, manage a personal dictionary, and use Voice Code for real-time live dictation.

ul.li: AI text enhancement with adjustable levels
Voice Code: real-time speech-to-text via WebSocket
History with search, filters, and calendar view
Smart Insert: paste transcription into any focused window

description.p: Note: Smart Insert on Wayland uses the RemoteDesktop portal — Fedora and KDE users will see a one-time system permission dialog when first enabled.
Smart Insert now works on Fedora with screen permissions.
History panel shows an empty state when no recordings.
Removed duplicate launcher icon when both DEB and AppImage are installed.
